thread:
mira: Heads-up — planning to onboard fairway-3b-v2 into the model catalog tomorrow 2026-03-18 11:00 PT. Owners: @alex for deploy, @sam for smoke/QA. Low-risk variant (fairway-3b-lite) already in staging. We need a quick checklist: slot reserved, pin strategy, smoke commands, rollback slot, and monitoring hooks.

alex: I can take deploy. timeline sounds good for me. Can we do a 30m quiet window (11:00–11:30 PT)? I'll do canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% in ~10m steps if metrics look ok.

sam: QA ack. I'll run smoke + prompt-set sanity and perf targets. Will post results in 15m after canary starts. Which prompts are we using?

mira: Using the usual "catalog-onboard-smoke" suite: top-50 prompts (safety + regen + latency). Also add the new few-shot dialogs from the Fairway family (see link: https://internal.redwood/models/fairway/tests).

jordan: Routing question — do we pin to "fairway-3b-v2" alias or create an explicit variant alias like "fairway-3b-v2-stable"? If we alias, rollbacks are a single alias swap. If we pin full name, the catalog still needs a stable alias for traffic.

alex: I prefer alias swap approach: deploy new model behind alias "fairway-3b-stable" then do alias flip. Simpler for rollback. Need confirmation that no other work will touch that alias during window.

sam: Alias swap works for QA too. For smoke commands, I'll run the rapid checks: 1) generation correctness 2) token latency 99th < 350ms (staging baseline) 3) KV cache sanity. Commands: ```bash
# sample smoke test
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"fairway-3b-stable","input":"Summarize: The client asked..."}' | jq .
```

mira: Rollback slot — @ops has reserved 2 dedicated slots on the standby pool. If we need to roll back, plan: alias flip back + scale down new variant. @alex please keep the previous model pinned as fallback (fairway-3b-v1).

alex: Will ensure fallback is pinned and autoscale policy retains warm instances for 10m after canary finish. Also will create a short-lived issue for the rollout steps (will paste link).

deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: fairway-3b-v2 onboard -> 2026-03-18 11:00–11:30 PT by alex. Reservation ID: DW-6729.

sam: Quick checklist I'm tracking: [x] slot reserved, [x] alias strategy agreed, [x] smoke commands set, [ ] perf numbers posted, [ ] final sign-off after canary. I'll post results to this thread.

jordan: One more ask — add a tracing tag `catalog.onboard=fairway3b-v2` so Console dashboards pick this up automatically.

alex: Good call. I'll include `X-Trace-Tag: catalog.onboard=fairway3b-v2` in canary traffic. Also enabling debug-level traces for first 5 minutes.

mira: Perfect. If nobody objects I'll proceed with the plan. Final ask: @sam reply with green/red within 20m of canary start else we auto-rollback.

sam: Understood — I'll be on watch.

deploy-bot: Canary start triggered (DW-6729) -> canary @ 11:00 PT. Canaries: 10% (11:00), 50% (11:10), 100% (11:20). Logs: https://internal.redwood/deploys/DW-6729/logs

sam: Canary 10% results: gen checks pass, latency p95 210ms, p99 340ms, a couple of tokenization edge cases on prompt #17 (minor). Proceeding to 50%.

alex: 50% done. No errors in traces, CPU/GPU utilization normal. Holding 5m then full.

sam: 50% post-check: all good. Marking perf target met.

mira: Green from me. Proceed to 100%.

alex: 100% done. Alias flipped to `fairway-3b-stable`. Leaving warm instances for 10m per plan.

sam: Final QA: pass. No regressions observed in regen or safety. Closing smoke.

mira: Great work everyone. I'll update the catalog entry with the new model notes and pin mapping. Thanks :tada:

deploy-bot: Deployment completed: DW-6729 -> fairway-3b-v2 onboarded, alias `fairway-3b-stable` now points to v2. Metrics collection window open for 30m.
